generation_context: fresh per initial candidate; no reference source, repository access or tools
repair_context: original requirements plus immediately previous raw output and capped actual checker feedback
acceptance: unchanged strict UTF-8 whole-response source assessment; source, model and correspondence must pass
closed_loop_selection: after all six chains terminal, lexicographically smallest accepted sample id; first accepted response in that chain
future_closed_loop_pairs: selected generated source versus same-interface handwritten calibration; same frozen schedules
